newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble lower after year-end non-resident selling.
newsitem.headline: Rouble lower after year-end non-resident selling.

text.p: The rouble edged down on Wednesday on plentiful supply after year-end book-closing and due to non-resident profit-taking in Russian government bonds, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Jan 8 midday Jan 8 early Jan 6 close
Tuesday, January 7, was a holiday in Russia.
"Dollar rates are at the upper limit of the central bank's rates and hardly changing," TOKObank dealer Stanislav Chernyakov said.
He added rouble supply could be high as banks had stopped actively seeking funds to square year-end balances.

Another dealer said the rouble could come under further pressure from dollar buying by non-residents repatriating profits from funds invested before Russia cut the guaranteed T-bill yield for non-residents in early October.
